A very difficult day in Baku. Time to regroup as a team for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.

items.titleZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛：博塔斯最后一圈撞墙，哈斯车队奥康第七、比尔曼第九
items.summaryZh: 哈斯车队在X上发帖播报阿塞拜疆大奖赛赛况：博塔斯在最后一圈撞上护墙且安然无恙，比赛还剩几个弯角结束，哈斯车手奥康位居第七，奥利位居第九。
items.originalTitle: Lap 51/51 BOT is into the wall on the final lap and is ok. A few corners to go... P7: Esteban 🇫🇷 P9: Ollie 🇬🇧 #HaasF1 #F1 #AzerbaijanGP
items.summaryEn:
Lap 51/51
BOT is into the wall on the final lap and is ok. A few corners to go... 
P7: Esteban 🇫🇷
P9: Ollie 🇬🇧
#HaasF1 #F1 #AzerbaijanGP
detailZh: 第51圈/共51圈：博塔斯在最后一圈撞上护墙，本人安然无恙。还剩几个弯角比赛就将结束……第七位：奥康；第九位：奥利。
detailEn:
Lap 51/51
BOT is into the wall on the final lap and is ok. A few corners to go... 
P7: Esteban 🇫🇷
P9: Ollie 🇬🇧
#HaasF1 #F1 #AzerbaijanGP
keyPointsZh: 帖子发布于比赛第51圈，即最后一圈，当时还剩几个弯角未完成。
博塔斯（BOT）在最后一圈撞上护墙，本人没有大碍。
哈斯车手奥康暂列第七位，奥利暂列第九位。
keyPointsEn: The post was published on lap 51, the final lap, with a few corners still to go.
Bottas (BOT) hit the wall on the last lap but was confirmed to be okay.
Haas drivers Ocon was running in P7 and Ollie in P9 at that moment.

items.titleZh: 梅赛德斯赛道快报：拉塞尔防守维斯塔潘，安东内利追赶勒克莱尔
items.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队在比赛第50至51圈更新战况：拉塞尔以约1秒的差距顶住维斯塔潘的进攻，安东内利暂列第五，继续追赶勒克莱尔争夺第四。
items.originalTitle: Lap 50/51: George is still keeping Max at bay with the gap floating around 1 second mark. Kimi is in P5 still chasing down Charles for P4.

Lap 50/51: 
George is still keeping Max at bay with the gap floating around 1 second mark.
 Kimi is in P5 still chasing down Charles for P4.
detailZh: 第50至51圈：拉塞尔继续顶住维斯塔潘，双方差距在1秒上下浮动。安东内利暂列第五，仍在追赶勒克莱尔争夺第四名。
detailEn:
Lap 50/51: 
George is still keeping Max at bay with the gap floating around 1 second mark.
 Kimi is in P5 still chasing down Charles for P4.
keyPointsZh: 拉塞尔与维斯塔潘的差距在1秒上下浮动，拉塞尔成功守住位置。
keyPointsEn: The gap between George Russell and Max is fluctuating around the 1 second mark, with Russell successfully holding his position.
